alkylation reagent: alkylated with 17 mM iodoacetamide for 20 min at room temperature.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 17 mM iodoacetamide for 20 min at room temperature.
cleavage agent: Proteins on beads were digested overnight with 1 μg of sequencing grade modified trypsin (Promega—Madison, WI, USA).
enrichment method: Biotinylated proteins were pulled down with 250 μL of prewashed streptavidin-coated magnetic beads (Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin T1).
instrument: Peptides were sent to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, St-Laurent, QC, Canada)
ionization type: through a Nanospray Flex Ion Source set to 1.3–1.8 kV
labeling: Labeled proteins were pulled down with streptavidin-coated magnetic beads and analyzed by mass spectrometry
reduction reagent: Resulting peptides were reduced in 9 mM dithiothreitol for 30 min at 37 °C
reduction concentration: Resulting peptides were reduced in 9 mM dithiothreitol for 30 min at 37 °C
